This Privacy Policy explains how Meet to Manage handles information when academies, teachers, parents and students use our website, web portals and parent mobile app.
We take care with children's information. Please read the section on children, and contact us if anything is unclear.
1. Who is responsible for your information

Meet to Manage is operated by Infinity Uniquers (“we”, “us”). The platform is used by academies, schools and independent educators (each an “Academy”). For information about an Academy's students, parents and staff, the Academy decides why and how it is used and we process it on the Academy's behalf. For our own website, sign-up, billing and support, we decide, and we are responsible for that information ourselves.
If you are a parent, student or teacher, your Academy is your first contact for questions about your child's records. We will help the Academy respond.
Account details: names, email addresses, phone numbers, role, time zone and sign-in PINs
Student and family details: child's name, age or grade, course and batch, parent or guardian contact details, and details the Academy chooses to record
Learning records: class schedules, attendance, progress reports, feedback, quiz and activity results and certificates
Class content: live audio and video, whiteboard content, chat messages and, where the Academy turns them on, recordings
Billing information: invoices, amounts, payment status and gateway references. Card and bank details are entered with the payment gateway and are not stored by us
Messages and support: tickets, enquiries, demo bookings and conversations with our assistants
AI features: the questions typed or spoken to the Mito study companion, the doubt chatbot or the website assistant
Device and usage data: app version, device type, IP address, log and error data, and security events
To run classes, schedules, attendance, reports, fee collection and notifications for the Academy
To provide the parent mobile app and the other portals
To create and secure accounts, prevent fraud and abuse, and keep the platform reliable
To bill Academies for their subscription and answer support requests
To produce AI replies when someone uses an AI feature
To improve the platform using aggregated or de-identified usage information
We do not sell personal information and we do not use children's information for advertising.

Most students on the platform are children. Their information is added by the Academy or by their parent or guardian, and the Academy is responsible for obtaining the consent of a parent or guardian that the law requires before a child's information is collected or a class is recorded.

We do not show advertising to children, do not build profiles of children for marketing, and do not track or monitor children's behaviour except as needed to deliver the learning service (for example attendance, progress and safety).
A parent or guardian can ask the Academy, or us, to access, correct or delete their child's information.

Where data-protection law requires a lawful ground, we rely on: the performance of our contract with the Academy; the consent of the parent, guardian or individual where consent is needed; our legitimate interests in securing and improving the service, balanced against your rights; and compliance with legal obligations.
Information is visible to the people the Academy gives access to, according to their role: for example a teacher sees their own batches, and a parent sees only their own children.
We use service providers that process information for us, under written terms, for:
AI language models that generate assistant replies
We may also disclose information when the law requires it, to protect safety or rights, or as part of a merger or sale of the business, in which case the new owner must honour this policy.

Our providers may process information in countries other than where you live. Where the law requires it, we use safeguards such as contractual protections so that your information is handled to a comparable standard.
Academy and student records are kept while the Academy's subscription is active, and the Academy can delete them
Class recordings are deleted at the end of the retention period of the Academy's plan
After a subscription ends, the Academy can export its data for 30 days, after which we may delete it
Billing and tax records are kept for as long as the law requires
Security and error logs are kept for a limited period

We use technical and organisational measures that include role-based access control, encrypted connections, activity logging and, in the parent mobile app, an optional biometric lock. Biometric checks are done by your phone's operating system and your fingerprint or face data does not leave your device. No online service can be completely secure, so please keep your PIN private and tell us if you suspect misuse.
Depending on where you live (for example India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, or the GDPR in Europe and the UK), you may have the right to:
Know what information we hold about you or your child and get a copy
Ask for deletion, or restrict or object to certain processing
Withdraw consent you gave, without affecting what happened before
Receive your information in a portable form
Nominate someone to exercise your rights, and make a complaint to the data-protection authority where you live
To use these rights, contact your Academy or write to us at the address below. We may need to verify your identity, and will answer within the time the law allows.

Our website and portals use cookies and similar storage to keep you signed in, remember your language and theme, keep the platform secure and understand how it is used. You can control cookies in your browser, but some features may stop working if you block them.

Our Terms of Service explain the contract with an Academy. Infinity Client Finder, another product from Infinity Uniquers, has its own policy at https://meettomanage.cloud/policy. An Academy may also publish its own terms and privacy notice for its families.
We may update this policy as the platform or the law changes. We will change the “Last updated” date and, for material changes, notify Academy administrators.

For privacy questions, requests or complaints, contact Infinity Uniquers at info@infinityuniquers.com. Please say which Academy you are connected with and include enough detail for us to find the record.

Meet to Manage is a learning management and virtual classroom platform operated by Infinity Uniquers (“we”, “us”). These terms form the agreement between us and the academy, school, institute, tutor or coach that subscribes to the platform (the “Academy”). They apply to the website, the web portals, the parent mobile app and any related service.

Parents, guardians, students and teachers use the platform through an Academy. Their relationship with the Academy (fees, refunds, class rules) is governed by the Academy's own terms, not these. We are not a party to those terms.

The person who signs up on behalf of the Academy must be authorised to bind it. The Academy is responsible for every account it creates, for keeping sign-in details and PINs confidential, and for removing access for people who leave.
Information you give us during sign-up must be accurate and kept up to date. Tell us at once if you suspect unauthorised use of an account.

Fees already paid are not refundable, except where applicable law requires it or where we agree otherwise in writing, for example if we are unable to provide the service for a sustained period.

6. The Academy's responsibilities for students' data

Academies teach children. Before adding a child or recording a class, the Academy must have the permission it needs: where a student is a minor, that means the consent of a parent or guardian, collected in a form that meets the law that applies to them.

The Academy is responsible for telling parents, students and teachers how their information is used, for the content it uploads, and for the terms it agrees with families, including its own fee and refund rules.
The Academy must tell participants that live classes may be recorded and must use recordings only for teaching, safeguarding and legitimate administrative purposes.

The Academy owns the data it and its users put into the platform (“Academy Data”). We act on the Academy's instructions to process it so that the platform works. For most Academy Data, the Academy decides why and how it is used and we process it on its behalf, as described in our Privacy Policy.

We process Academy Data only to provide, secure, support and improve the service, and as the law requires. We do not sell it. We use other companies for hosting, video, payments, messaging and AI features, and we require them to protect the data.
If the Academy needs a written data processing agreement, for example because it serves families in the European Economic Area or the UK, contact us and we will provide one.

Class recordings are kept for the retention period of the Academy's plan and then deleted. The Academy can delete a recording sooner. We are not responsible for recordings that the Academy or its users download and keep elsewhere.
